digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciliation differ and mutation filtering
propositions: The raw differ emits field_drift for mismatched local and remote state per its documented contract, which is a load-bearing positive control for callers honoring the API
The production snapshot caller passes both arguments as remote Jira state, violating the raw differ contract; A4-1 filters differ-owned field_drift and unbound_local at that call site
The call-site filter must remain in place so future migration to real local state can remove it without weakening the pure differ API
Verification testing confirms the raw differ emits its positive control while the production result contains zero outbound updates for the same key-set entry
Genuine inbound-create and invariant-seed mutations survive the call-site filter, and converged passes record mutation_count == 0
